# The Evidence Pack, generated by code (T27, Spec af-wf4w5r §10, §9 point 6)

## What it is for

At the end of a Spec, Benjamin judges the launched product with one page
beside it: the **Evidence Pack**. In a convoy that carries the **new-flow
mark**, code writes that page from what is recorded and from nothing else.
No agent writes a word of it (user story 62), and it always says what the
proofs do **not** cover.

`bin/evidence-pack` is the command. `bin/convoy-advance` has the pack
generated once the six conditions before it are met; `bin/spec-end` reads it
as its seventh and last condition (`docs/SPEC_END.md`).

```bash
./bin/evidence-pack generate af-convoy --repo <project repository>   # writes the page, records it on the convoy
./bin/evidence-pack check    af-convoy --repo <project repository>   # does the recorded pack still hold? reads only
```

A convoy **without** the mark is not concerned: both commands answer « pas
un convoi du nouveau flux » (exit 4) and write nothing.

## What the page is made of

| Source | Read through |
| --- | --- |
| The state of the convoy and of each ticket | `bin/convoy-state show` |
| The verdict of each condition of the end of the Spec, on the tip of the integration branch as it is now | `bin/spec-end check --before-pack` (conditions 1 to 6: the pack is not a verdict on itself) |
| The Spec: its numbered user stories, its Validated Prototype, the inventory of the states of each screen | the Spec bead, read by `bin/spec-approve outline` |
| Each piece of the evidence store the tracker names | `bin/evidence-capture verify`, then the sealed record |
| The fixed lines of « Ce qui n'a PAS été vérifié » | `config/evidence-pack.json` |

Every sentence of the page is a fixed line of the command or of that file;
every value is a recorded one. The command takes **no text from its
caller**: it has no option that carries one. Two generations on the same
state write the same bytes: the page carries no time of generation.

A piece the evidence store refuses (absent, rewritten, not sealed by the
tool) is **said**, with the reason of the tool, and nothing of its content
is shown.

## The rubrics (Spec §10, in order)

| # | Rubric | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | En-tête | The Spec and its digest (the text read, and the digest the publication door wrote on the convoy), the convoy, the integration branch, the commit, the protected branch, the verdict of each condition of the end of the Spec with what was read. « Dossier non conforme » and the conditions that are not met, when one is not. |
| 2 | Ce qui demande les yeux de Benjamin | Each finding « hors ticket » kept as a proposal; the fidelity deviations the Evaluator of the end listed; the deviations the mechanical checks measured; for each prototyped state and rendering, **the two captures side by side and the image of their difference**; the remarks of exploration with their pieces; each mention « même fournisseur ou même modèle que l'auteur », and apart each independence nobody recorded. |
| 3 | Ce qui n'a PAS été vérifié | **Mandatory.** The states of each screen the Spec lists as « non prototypé » (and those « sans objet », with their reason); the criteria of the quality baseline that have no mechanism; the known limits of the controls; and what this very delivery leaves unverified: a piece refused by the store, a story not observed, a capture taken at another commit, a condition that is not met. |
| 4 | Par user story | The state and the piece of the Outcome Evaluation, the tickets that cover the story, its repair. |
| 5 | Par ticket | The demonstration line with the proof of the author and the state of the Ticket Evaluation, each criterion with its state and piece, the refusals and resumes, the nine verdicts of the ticket-end gate. |
| 6 | Éléments suivis | Each deviation, each « non fait » and each finding « hors ticket » with its final state. |
| 7 | Hors graphe initial | The `repair` tickets created and what each restores, the Planning Exceptions and the answers of Benjamin, the overrides with his words, the stops and requests raised. |
| 8 | Relevés | The files touched outside the Declared Scope, the models per role, the duration, the rounds of the end (« Tours de fin » : the count, the last tip counted and its source, and, T26, the stop of the rounds when there is one), the contradictions between the proof of a ticket and the end of the Spec. |
| 9 | Preuves TDD et constats de revue | Per ticket: red, freeze, green with their pieces, the review of the tests, each round of the code review with every finding, blocking or not; then the end code review. |

Rubric 0 of the Spec, « Depuis ton dernier jugement », belongs to the second
pack of an Outcome: it comes with the record of the acceptance (T29, T30).

## « Ce qui n'a PAS été vérifié » cannot be left out

`config/evidence-pack.json` holds two lists, both required and non-empty:

- `baseline_without_mechanism`: `{criterion, detail}` for each criterion of
  the quality baseline the Spec gives no mechanism to (Further Notes 1). A
  line leaves the list only with the control that verifies it.
- `known_limits`: one line per known limit of the controls of the flow.

The file of the Factory root in use (`FACTORY_ROOT`) is read; a root that
has none is read under the Factory's own file.

**Generation is refused, and nothing is written**, when the rubric cannot be
filled: a list absent, empty or malformed, the file unreadable, or a Spec
that names a Validated Prototype without the inventory of the states of its
screens. A Spec that names no Validated Prototype fills the rubric with one
fixed line: no state of a screen is prototyped.

## Where the pack is, and its record

```
<packs>/<spec id>/<convoy id>/<commit>/index.html          the page
<packs>/<spec id>/<convoy id>/<commit>/pieces/<sha256>.json  a sealed record the page links
<packs>/<spec id>/<convoy id>/<commit>/pieces/<sha256>.png   an image the page shows
```

`<packs>` is `EVIDENCE_PACK_DIR`, default
`~/.local/state/agent-factory-evidence-packs`. It is refused inside a Git
work tree: a pack carries pieces of the evidence store. Each file under
`pieces/` is named by its fingerprint, so the fingerprint of the page covers
everything it shows. The page is static: no script, nothing fetched from
elsewhere than its folder.

The pack is recorded on the convoy by `bin/convoy-state
record-evidence-pack` (`gc.flow.evidence_pack`, rendered as
`convoy.evidence_pack`): `commit`, `digest` (of the page), `path`,
`conforming`, `inadmissible` (the number of pieces the store refused),
`version` (`evidence-pack/v1`), `at`. The same pack again writes nothing.

## A red condition does not refuse the page

`generate` on a convoy one of whose conditions 1 to 6 is not met writes the
page, with « Dossier non conforme » in its header and the verdict of each
condition; the record carries `conforming: false`. It is the page of the
« non conforme » request (T26): once the repair rounds of the end are
stopped, `bin/convoy-advance` has it generated on the refused tip and sends
its link to the operator (`docs/CONVOY_ADVANCE.md`, « The rounds of the end
are bounded »).

**The stop is in rubric 8, the request is not.** Under « Tours de fin »,
a convoy that carries `end_stop` gets one more line: « Tours de réparation
de fin arrêtés (<cause>) au commit …, le … : <detail>. Aucun tour de plus
ne démarre ; une demande « non conforme » part vers l'opérateur. » — the
cause being « tours de réparation épuisés », « un tour n'a pas réduit les
user stories non observées » or « la même user story refusée deux fois ».
The request itself (its bead, its options) is not printed: it is written
once the page exists and carries the page's link, so printing it would
outdate the page it points to. A convoy whose rounds are not stopped gets
no such line.

## One commit more outdates the pack

`check` answers one `state`:

| State | When | Exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `à jour` | The commit of the pack is the tip of the integration branch, the page and its pieces are the bytes that were written, what the recorded state gives now is still that page, no piece was refused. | 0 |
| `absent` | No pack is recorded on the convoy. | 1 |
| `périmé` | The integration branch holds one commit more; or a record the page shows changed since (a verdict, a review, a classification…). It is to generate again. | 1 |
| `altéré` | The page or a piece it shows no longer has its fingerprint, or is missing. | 1 |
| `incomplet` | A piece the page names was refused by the evidence store. | 1 |

`check` writes nothing. The end-of-Spec gate reads it as condition 7
(`evidence_pack`), once conditions 1 to 6 are met, and **refuses without a
complete pack that holds**.

## Refusals and exit status

Every answer is one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 done, or the pack holds;
1 refused, or the pack does not hold; 3 the convoy is in an « état sans
règle »; 4 the convoy does not carry the mark. A refusal writes nothing.
`generate` refuses a missing `--repo`, a convoy without an integration
branch, a convoy that names no Spec or whose Spec has no numbered user
stories, and the rubric that cannot be filled.

## Limits

- **The captures side by side are those of the tickets.** The pack shows,
  per prototyped state and rendering, the comparison piece of the interface
  ticket merged last, taken at that ticket's commit; none is made again at
  the commit of the pack (the end-of-Spec gate files no piece,
  `docs/SPEC_END.md`). The page says so on each capture and in rubric 3.
- **A fidelity deviation the Evaluator of the end lists is a line**, with an
  optional piece: nothing ties it to one capture.
- **No address of a launched product in the header.** Nothing launches the
  product at generation; the header gives the addresses the Outcome
  Evaluation ran on, stopped since. The Acceptance Session launches it at
  the commit of the pack, and refuses a pack that `check` does not say
  « à jour » (T28, `bin/acceptance-session open`,
  `docs/ACCEPTANCE_SESSION.md`).
- **The baseline list is the four families the Spec names** (code health,
  architecture, dependencies, secrets): the classification of its thirteen
  criteria is an open point of the Spec.
- **`check` builds the page again** to compare it: every piece is verified
  at each call, which the gate makes at each pass once conditions 1 to 6 are
  green. Not measured on a real convoy.
- **Nothing purges a pack.** A pack of an earlier commit stays in its own
  folder.
- **No real convoy was packed.** The page was opened in a headless Chromium
  on the fixture only.

## Proof

- `tests/evidence-pack-test.py`: the command lines on a fake tracker state,
  on the delivered and evaluated convoy of the Delivery Fixture City, every
  piece sealed by the real `bin/evidence-capture`. The header and the nine
  rubrics in order; two generations byte for byte; the mandatory rubric and
  each refusal that leaves nothing written; proposals, captures and
  mentions; contradictions, repairs, Planning Exceptions, overrides and
  files outside the Declared Scope in their rubrics; « non conforme »; a
  pack outdated by one commit more, by a changed record, rewritten by hand,
  or short of a piece; the gate refusing without a pack and passing its
  seven conditions with it. T26: the stop of the rounds said in rubric 8,
  unchanged once the request is recorded, and no such line on a convoy that
  is not stopped; Delivered recorded by the gate (`docs/SPEC_END.md`).
- `tests/convoy-state-test.py`: `record-evidence-pack` and its refusals, a
  record written outside the command.
- `tests/convoy-advance-test.py`: the pass generates the pack once the six
  conditions before it are met, runs the gate again, and generates nothing
  on the same state.
- `tests/spec-approve-test.py`: the inventory of the states read by
  `outline`.
